name: agent-jury
description: agent-jury - a review loop that ends: fresh judges, a fixed bar, two independent verdicts, DISPUTED for a human.

plugins.name: agent-jury
plugins.description: Runs a draft through independent judges against an explicit rubric until it passes, without the bar creeping up between rounds. Two judges confirm the final PASS; when they disagree without evidence, the verdict is DISPUTED and a human decides. Ships a CLI that keeps the state and enforces the rules.
